_what: What tool:measure-first-frame reads once: the defaults of a run and the bar a run is compared with. The bar is what the Oct 2026 files path measured for the person (streaming-bar.md section 1.1, lane streaming-bar, Nov 17 2026); each number names its source line. `cold` is a fresh browser (nothing cached); `warm` is the same browser's second visit. Seconds are seconds, bytes are bytes.

first_frame_cold_seconds.source: streaming-bar.md 1.1: 33 GB C9638 first read on the first device 5.93 s; cold 5.5-5.9 s waits on the store

first_frame_warm_seconds.source: streaming-bar.md 1.1: 33 GB first frame through the Finder drive, warm, 2.89 s (commit 40696f077e)

bytes_to_first_frame.source: streaming-bar.md 1.1: 17 MB fetched to play the 33 GB file's first frame (core/tests/acceptance.rs:36,66)
